description:
Screen recorder with automatic zoom, cursor focus and local editing.

Record product demos and tutorials with automatic zoom, cursor focus and local editing on Windows and Mac. Click to Reel records a display, window, or selected area with GPU acceleration, lets the camera follow important actions without keyframes, and offers light timeline editing: split clips, remove segments, adjust speed, and add a background before exporting a video ready to share. Recording and export up to 1080P are free.
